motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disable deal, prompt, pulse animations and interactive transitions.

components.name: Primary button
components.css: .ds-button-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:3px;font:500 15px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:color 150ms ease-out,background-color 150ms ease-out,border-color 150ms ease-out;border:0;background:rgb(var(--ink, 29 39 62));color:rgb(var(--paper, 243 245 249))}.ds-button-primary:hover{background:rgb(var(--ink-soft, 69 81 106));}.ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid rgb(var(--accent, 44 74 161));outline-offset:2px}.ds-button-primary:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.5}.ds-button-primary:active{background:rgb(var(--ink, 29 39 62))}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-primary{transition:none}}

components.name: Accent button
components.css: .ds-button-accent{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:3px;font:500 15px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:color 150ms ease-out,background-color 150ms ease-out,border-color 150ms ease-out;border:0;background:rgb(var(--accent, 44 74 161));color:rgb(var(--accent-ink, 255 255 255))}.ds-button-accent:hover{background:rgb(var(--accent-hover, 32 56 128));}.ds-button-accent:focus-visible{outline:2px solid rgb(var(--accent, 44 74 161));outline-offset:2px}.ds-button-accent:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.5}.ds-button-accent:active{background:rgb(var(--accent, 44 74 161))}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-accent{transition:none}}

components.name: Secondary button
components.css: .ds-button-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:3px;font:500 15px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:color 150ms ease-out,background-color 150ms ease-out,border-color 150ms ease-out;border:1px solid rgb(var(--line-strong, 167 181 205));background:transparent;color:rgb(var(--ink, 29 39 62))}.ds-button-secondary:hover{background:rgb(var(--surface-sunken, 231 236 245));border-color:rgb(var(--ink-soft, 69 81 106));}.ds-button-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid rgb(var(--accent, 44 74 161));outline-offset:2px}.ds-button-secondary:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.5}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-secondary{transition:none}}

components.name: Labeled field
components.description: Raised bordered field with the implemented focus ring.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-title">Title</label><input id="ds-title" class="ds-field" placeholder="Give it a title">
components.css: .ds-label{display:block;margin-bottom:8px;font:500 14px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif;color:rgb(var(--ink-soft, 69 81 106))}.ds-field{width:100%;padding:10px 14px;border:1px solid rgb(var(--line-strong, 167 181 205));border-radius:3px;background:rgb(var(--surface-raised, 255 255 255));color:rgb(var(--ink, 29 39 62));font:400 15px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif;outline:none;transition:border-color 150ms}.ds-field::placeholder{color:rgb(var(--muted, 91 104 128))}.ds-field:focus{border-color:rgb(var(--ink-soft, 69 81 106));box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgb(var(--accent, 44 74 161) / .2)}.ds-field:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.6}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-field{transition:none}}

components.name: Navigation band
components.description: Cobalt navigation with an active underline.
components.html: Your deskCritiqueStories
components.css: .ds-navigation{display:flex;gap:10px;background:rgb(var(--shell-blue, 35 61 137));color:rgb(var(--shell-ink, 246 249 255));padding:0 16px}.ds-nav-link{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:52px;padding:0 9px;font:400 13px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif;color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.ds-nav-link:hover{background:rgb(255 255 255 / .08)}.ds-nav-active{font-weight:600}.ds-nav-active::after{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:0;left:9px;right:9px;height:3px;background:currentColor}.ds-nav-link:focus-visible{outline:2px solid rgb(var(--shell-ink, 246 249 255));outline-offset:-4px}

components.name: Genre chip
components.description: Rectangular selection control with an active state.
components.css: .ds-chips{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.ds-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;padding:4px 12px;border:1px solid rgb(var(--line-strong, 167 181 205));border-radius:3px;color:rgb(var(--ink-soft, 69 81 106));background:transparent;font:400 14px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:color 150ms,border-color 150ms}.ds-chip:hover{color:rgb(var(--ink, 29 39 62));border-color:rgb(var(--ink-soft, 69 81 106))}.ds-chip-active,.ds-chip-active:hover{background:rgb(var(--ink, 29 39 62));color:rgb(var(--paper, 243 245 249));border-color:rgb(var(--ink, 29 39 62))}.ds-chip:focus-visible{outline:2px solid rgb(var(--accent, 44 74 161));outline-offset:2px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-chip{transition:none}}

components.name: Work card
components.description: Flat shared card with ruled header and 20px padding.
components.html:
Shared draft

Writing with another person.

Changes in this room are shared.
components.css: .ds-card{border:1px solid rgb(var(--line, 212 221 234));border-radius:3px;background:rgb(var(--surface, 247 249 252));color:rgb(var(--ink, 29 39 62))}.ds-card-header{padding:20px;border-bottom:1px solid rgb(var(--line, 212 221 234))}.ds-card-header h3{margin:0;font:600 18px/1.5 var(--font-serif, Georgia),serif;letter-spacing:-.015em}.ds-card-header p{margin:4px 0 0;font:400 14px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif;color:rgb(var(--muted, 91 104 128))}.ds-card-body{padding:20px;font:400 16px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif}

components.name: Starting-point sheet
components.description: The home prompt uses cobalt and literary type.
components.html:
A starting point

Begin with a sentence. See where it takes you.

Write from this prompt
components.css: .ds-prompt{padding:22px 30px 25px;border-radius:4px;background:rgb(var(--prompt-blue, 40 66 148));color:rgb(var(--prompt-ink, 255 255 255))}.ds-prompt header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}.ds-prompt h2{margin:0;font:500 13px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif}.ds-prompt button{display:grid;place-items:center;width:44px;height:44px;background:transparent;color:inherit;border:1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / .3);border-radius:3px;cursor:pointer}.ds-prompt button:hover{background:rgb(255 255 255 / .12)}.ds-prompt p{margin:0;padding:25px 0;font:400 23px/1.5 var(--font-serif, Georgia),serif}.ds-prompt footer{border-top:1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / .23);padding-top:15px}.ds-prompt a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;font:400 13px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif;color:inherit;text-underline-offset:5px}.ds-prompt button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid rgb(var(--prompt-ink, 255 255 255));outline-offset:2px}.ds-prompt a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid rgb(var(--prompt-ink, 255 255 255));outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Story row
components.description: An open contents row for published writing.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-story{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:4px 32px;padding:24px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgb(var(--line, 212 221 234));color:rgb(var(--ink, 29 39 62));text-decoration:none}.ds-story h3{margin:0;font:500 1.4rem/1.375 var(--font-serif, Georgia),serif;letter-spacing:-.015em;transition:color 150ms}.ds-story:hover h3{color:rgb(var(--accent, 44 74 161))}.ds-byline,.ds-story time{margin:4px 0 0;font:400 14px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif;color:rgb(var(--muted, 91 104 128))}.ds-excerpt{max-width:65ch;margin:8px 0 0;font:400 16px/1.75 var(--font-serif, Georgia),serif;color:rgb(var(--ink-soft, 69 81 106))}.ds-story:focus-visible{outline:2px solid rgb(var(--accent, 44 74 161));outline-offset:2px}@media(max-width:639px){.ds-story{grid-template-columns:1fr}.ds-story time{order:-1}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-story h3{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
Writers’ Workshop presents writing as shared craft. Cool paper, cobalt navigation, clear editorial rules, and a drawn paragraph mark give the interface the character of a contemporary small press. The screen stays useful and direct, with space for a writer’s words and compact controls around them.

Literata carries authored words and literary headings; Courier Prime marks work in progress; the system sans stack carries tools and metadata. Surfaces remain flat and quietly separated. The same relationships continue into a blue night palette without adding physical texture.
keyCharacteristics: Cool paper and cobalt, with a separate night palette.
Literary serif, manuscript mono, and compact sans have distinct jobs.
Bordered work surfaces, open lists, and quiet reading measure.
Plain labels make local, shared, and public consequences visible.

rules.name: The Visible State Rule
rules.body: Pair color with a readable label, underline, border, or status message so that selection and consequences remain understandable.

rules.name: The Authored Words Rule
rules.body: Use Literata for literary headings and published prose, Courier Prime for manuscript text, and sans for controls and metadata.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Use borders and tonal changes for ordinary work surfaces. Reserve the implemented deep shadow for the modal dialog.

dos: Do keep controls legible, named, and visibly focused; standard buttons have a minimum height of 44px.
Do use the theme tokens for both light and dark surfaces.
Do let titles and user-written text wrap, and keep published prose at the established reading measure.
Do use the existing paragraph mark and inline SVG icons.
Do state device storage, shared-room behavior, and public publication in plain language.
donts: Don’t reintroduce the superseded red-and-cream palette or faux ruled-card decoration.
Don’t use the system sans stack as a display face for literary headings.
Don’t add decorative uppercase eyebrows, emoji icons, or hard offset shadows.
Don’t replace the typographic story list with a cover-art grid when no such assets exist.
Don’t add fictional activity, testimonials, or member statistics.
